purpose: Data model for all user-configurable settings; serialized to/from config.json via ConfigManager.
invariants: CpuThresholdPercent is always one of {10, 20, 30, 40, 50} after normalization
MinimumSystemIdleFailSafeWindowMs = 6000 is a lower bound enforced by ConfigManager
gotchas: NormalizeCpuThresholdPercent rounds to nearest 10 — 15 becomes 20, 14 becomes 10; callers must use this before storing
AppArguments and TrayIconPath are intentionally NOT validated here; TargetFilePolicy owns path validation
